Accepted: the inner eval final expression is always a defined hash reference on success, and Perl clears$@ on successful eval. An exceptional exit assignsundef to$result and nonempty$@, so bothguards reject. If an exception object overloads booleanfalse, the relaxed guard reaches JSON::PP allow_nonref(0), which rejectsundef; the new outer eval then emits exactly the same graph_execution_failed envelope.
